checks: No selection or no explicit style disables Apply; pending selection format blocks Save; Cancel preserves the scene
Apply formats a selection crossing two differently colored, raised/lowered runs
One keyboard undo/redo restores the complete mixed-format scene
Real download XML changes all six supported properties only in intended character ranges; original baseline/color outside them remains intact
Saved file reopens with the same rendered scene and editable selection; Escape cancels

finalProductionNativeEquivalence.assertion: Final production export and natively opened export contain byte-identical uncompressed package parts.

limitations: Character/run budget cases exercise the new action layer directly; large-document import performance is outside this suite.
Reference-editor open/re-save is a separate acceptance step.
Fields, links, relationship-bearing text, symbol fonts and unsafe XML remain rejected.
This test proves bounded character-format edits, not universal typography or text-layout fidelity.
Native open only; no native re-save of the sixth-iteration files was tested.
Numeric baseline rendering, advanced typography, and font substitution are not pixel-equivalent to the reference editor.
No Windows/macOS installer built or published; Word/Excel engines unchanged.
